title: kith-tui client.rs ignores SSE id: field for reconnect
description: client.rs run_sse and spawn_sse never read the SSE id: field from the stream (parse_sse_event ignores it, line 136). When reconnecting after a disconnect, no Last-Event-ID header is sent. The server cannot use resumption to replay missed events. The TUI recovers via Message/changes on the next SSE state event, but any events that occurred during the gap may be missed until the next SSE event arrives. Contrast with watch.rs which correctly tracks last_event_id and sends Last-Event-ID on reconnect. This is an inconsistency between the two SSE parsers.
